verdict.rationale: cubic documents a Memory & Learning feature in which it analyzes experienced reviewers' historical PR comments and extracts learnings that it then enforces. That is a first-party mechanism for building persistent review memory, though the evidence only details the onboarding seeding step. The auto-maintained AI wiki adds persistent codebase context, but it is adjacent to agent memory rather than memory itself. missing for 10: evidence that memory is built continuously and automatically from ongoing interactions (e.g., feedback on comments), documentation of how learnings are recalled across later reviews and sessions, user visibility or editing of stored memories, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions

citations.quote: cubic analyzes their historical PR comments to extract learnings from the patterns they consistently enforce.
